title: schoenus ornithopodioides
intro: Schoenus ornithopodioides, commonly known as cotton-grass or sea grass, is a type of sedge plant native to coastal areas in the Northern Hemisphere. It is a perennial plant with a tall, slender stem and a distinctive inflorescence that resembles a cotton ball, hence its common name. The health benefits of Schoenus ornithopodioides include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Schoenus ornithopodioides include sesquiterpenoids, which may be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
